notes: v2.9.40: concrete and accumulation are tightened again. A concrete box is now valid only when its resistance/top stays below EMA112 throughout the detected box formation; being merely below EMA224 is no longer enough. If the box top reaches EMA112, it is rejected as concrete and may only be treated as another resistance structure. Accumulation is reduced to two unmistakable patterns only: a clearly long upper wick with burst volume, or a true large bearish dump with even stronger burst volume. Current volume must still exceed the previous bar. Short-upper-wick candles, ordinary bearish candles, flat/ambiguous shapes, and candles that are only high-volume without the required shape are all excluded. Clear long-wick burst bars can stand alone as accumulation, while nearby repeated clear bars still collapse to the single strongest display marker. Bowl-3, watermelon, breakout, pullback, condition-search, zoom and live-order rules remain unchanged.
